{{Quote|Hey... ain't this one of the kids who threw that mudball? You think he likes playing with mud?"<br />"Maybe so. Bet we could arrange for him to be sold to the lava mines on Vanan...|Two Herdessan shocktroopers|<ref name="SW88" />}}
'''Finn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] native of [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Herdessa/Legends|Herdessa]], who helped lead a lower-class revolution that toppled the ruling [[Herdessan Guild]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Along with his lover [[Suzu]], Finn attended the arrival of a delegation from the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] that had arrived to establish diplomatic relations with the Herdessan Guild, and threw a ball of mud that struck Alliance leader [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] in the ace. They were immediately hunted by [[Herdessan shocktrooper|security forces]] led by the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Lumiya]], and although Suzu managed to escape, Finn was captured to be sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. However, Suzu and Organa were able to free Finn and a number of other [[Prison/Legends|prisoners]], and [[Battle of Herdessa (Nagai–Tof War)|rose up]] against the guild and their Imperial allies. Finn was reunited with Suzu, and the guild members were captured and overthrown.<ref name="SW88" />
